messageSystem: Jethos cannot move assets you have not deposited or separately approved.
See the route, not just the result.
principles: Assets in the connected wallet are not invested automatically.
A vault deposit is an explicit on-chain action.
Invested capital follows public smart-contract rules and approved integrations.
Risk and liquidity remain present and must be communicated.
Live, recorded, estimated and illustrative data must never be confused.

statuses.poc: Private deployment used for controlled validation
statuses.implemented: Present in the repository, not necessarily a public product
statuses.live: Read from chain with a timestamp
